title: serapias cordigera subsp. neglecta
intro: Serapias cordigera subsp. neglecta, commonly known as the yellow bee orchid, is a subspecies of the yellow bee orchid, a type of orchid native to Europe and North Africa. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Serapias cordigera subsp. neglecta are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
